name: Jason Duval
short_description: Jason Duval is a Leonida Keys criminal associate whose plans become intertwined with Lucia Caminos after they meet.
long_description: Jason grew up around grifters and crooks and later spent time in the Army while trying to leave his troubled teenage years behind.
